description:
## Functional specifications
Extend existing DS components: connector/channel/thread information and author attribution; People access grouped by connector with manual/provider origins and capability-gated refresh. No strategy selector. Use Event/NodeRouter and trusted admin context. Test nil/legacy projections, long/escaped IDs, unauthorized refresh and unsupported/unavailable capability distinctions. Recheck existing labels against the canonical transcript model. Final UX approval still precedes new E2E authoring.

## Files and ownership
lib/zaq_web/live/bo/system/people_live.ex and template; shared DS components; People LiveView tests

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse validated refresh Action via Event/NodeRouter with session-derived actor. Scope refresh to Person+connector; show capability unavailable until downstream wiring. Do not label manual history access membership.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
applicable People/Channels guide; Storybook

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.

comments.text: Human approved extending existing People detail UI without separate prototype; reuse existing design system, obtain final UX approval before new E2E.

title: [zaq-emb.10] People external-channel grants and membership refresh UI
